lines.text: Many learners say: I listen music every day.
Better: I listen to music every day.
To! I listen to the radio.

data.right: I listen to music every day.

native.tip: listen 뒤에는 꼭 to! “I listen to music every day”예요.
native.caption: “I listen music every day”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 listen 바로 뒤에 목적어를 두지 말고 to를 넣어요. “I listen to music every day”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “to”. listen to 세트로 외워요! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Always put to after listen. Say “I listen to music every day”.
en.caption: Do you say “I listen music every day”? 😅 Do not put music right after listen. Add “to”. “I listen to music every day” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
